title: Tick 0rx's description names the golden at a path it left at tick 4i8
body:
The tick's description says the dashboard golden lives in internal/statusmodel/contract.json; that file moved into the pinned contract bundle (contracts/status-model.json) at tick 4i8, before this tick ran. A worker following the description's path literally hits a missing file; the intended reading — 'the same way other tests import ../../contracts/*.json' — is what the test does. Worth correcting in the tick record so a re-run does not stumble on the stale path.
evidence: contracts/status-model.json holds golden 'dashboard'; git log dbd6b8cf 'contracts: ticfac authors its own bundle' removed internal/statusmodel/contract.json
